scope: Documentation handoff; no application implementation or deployment performed.

guides.title: Run integration tests against the real API and PostGIS
guides.pr_boundary: One harness PR; regression scenarios are added by their owning PRs.

guides.title: Patch frontend dependencies and verify map compatibility
guides.pr_boundary: One dependency/migration PR; no feature redesign.

guides.title: Distinguish live data, demo fixtures, empty collections, and unavailable stores
guides.pr_boundary: One API/configuration/UI state PR.

guides.title: Introduce shared transactions and safe item mutations
guides.pr_boundary: One storage foundation PR; migrate callers in the explicitly dependent PRs.

guides.title: Preserve source identity and merge ingestion batches safely
guides.pr_boundary: One source identity and canonical batch-merge PR.

guides.title: Fetch a declared pilot scope completely and report source coverage
guides.pr_boundary: One ingestion coverage PR across the current ArcGIS connectors; no new sources.

guides.title: Retain agenda documents and reviewer decisions across refreshes
guides.pr_boundary: One agenda identity/merge PR.

guides.title: Make review actions explicit, durable, and revision checked
guides.pr_boundary: One review API/UI policy PR.

guides.title: Publish canonical changes and durable history in one transaction
guides.pr_boundary: One publication service/events PR; matching and mail are separate.

guides.title: Validate geometry and limit public write abuse
guides.pr_boundary: One public API input/limits PR.

guides.title: Generate future-change watch alerts through a durable outbox
guides.pr_boundary: One matcher/outbox PR; delivery stays disabled.

guides.title: Confirm watch subscriptions and make unsubscribe links work
guides.pr_boundary: One subscription lifecycle API/UI PR.

guides.title: Deliver outbox messages with leases, retries, and clear failure states
guides.pr_boundary: One delivery-worker hardening PR.

guides.title: Establish a reproducible map performance baseline
guides.pr_boundary: One measurement/fixture PR; no optimization yet.

guides.title: Serve a small layer catalog and stop eager bulk overlay downloads
guides.pr_boundary: One immediate startup-relief PR; tiles remain a later step.

guides.title: Import versioned environmental geometry into indexed PostGIS storage
guides.pr_boundary: One additive schema/import PR; no tile endpoint or display simplification.

guides.title: Prepare display geometry and activate complete layer versions atomically
guides.pr_boundary: One spatial display-preprocessing/activation PR.

guides.title: Serve bounded, cached environmental vector tiles
guides.pr_boundary: One read-only tile API PR.

guides.title: Render catalog-driven vector overlays without bulk GeoJSON
guides.pr_boundary: One environmental map-client PR.

guides.title: Add an indexed viewport query for development summaries
guides.pr_boundary: One derived map-index/API PR; the canonical public record remains unchanged.

guides.title: Query developments by viewport and avoid redundant map work
guides.pr_boundary: One development map/list client PR.

guides.title: Enforce map payload and performance budgets in CI
guides.pr_boundary: One performance-regression CI PR.

guides.title: Make filters complete and map state shareable
guides.pr_boundary: One filter/state/disclosure UI PR.

guides.title: Add a contextual basemap and local record search
guides.pr_boundary: One map orientation/search PR.

guides.title: Replace shared coordinate inputs with explicit location selection
guides.pr_boundary: One participation UX PR.

guides.title: Let reviewers validate and correct a candidate location
guides.pr_boundary: One reviewer geometry-editing PR.

guides.title: Merge confirmed duplicates without losing URLs or provenance
guides.pr_boundary: One manual merge preview/apply PR; no automatic matching engine.

guides.title: Calculate environmental screening from complete canonical geometry
guides.pr_boundary: One screening-engine replacement PR for existing wetlands/floodplain rules.

guides.title: Upload and verify ingestion artifacts before activating data
guides.pr_boundary: One artifact-storage adapter/manifest PR.

guides.title: Update hosted configuration and readiness checks for the new contracts
guides.pr_boundary: One configuration/preflight PR; no deployment action.

guides.title: Prepare code-license, data-use, and public disclosure decisions
guides.pr_boundary: One documentation/configuration inventory PR.

guides.title: Rehearse migration, recovery, and resident/reviewer workflows
guides.pr_boundary: One acceptance-runbook and evidence PR; fix discovered defects in focused follow-ups.

guides.title: Add one authoritative protected-land or refuge layer
guides.pr_boundary: One source adapter/configuration PR for one dataset.

guides.title: Choose a comparable land-cover product and lock a small fixture
guides.pr_boundary: One bounded research/fixture PR, at most three working days.

guides.title: Build versioned pilot raster tiles and comparison summaries
guides.pr_boundary: One offline raster build/serve PR for the two selected years only.

guides.title: Show a two-year land-cover and imperviousness comparison
guides.pr_boundary: One comparison UI PR using the prepared raster products.

guides.title: Evaluate God’s Eye View with one bounded integration experiment
guides.pr_boundary: Separate experimental branch; maximum five working days.

guides.title: Make current map filters show the intended records
guides.pr_boundary: One small correctness PR on current endpoints; do this before the larger map refactor.
